scope: Local supervised Linux VM native-game proof of concept; excluded from generic source/image allowlists

puttPuttZooDemo.title: Putt-Putt Saves the Zoo (Windows Demo)
puttPuttZooDemo.edition: HE 72 / Demo / Windows / English; upstream v2.9.0 HE0 hash match and installed Debian ARM64 ScummVM detection passed

extraction.policy: Validated exact eight-entry flat inventory, no duplicate/traversal/absolute/backslash/drive paths, encrypted members, links or special files; stored/deflate only; read and CRC-checked every bounded member; extracted only ZOODEMO.HE0 through HE4 with read-only modes. Windows executable, W32 component and help file retained only inside the original ZIP and never executed.

license.status: Proprietary Humongous demo data; redistribution permission not established
license.readmeOrLicenseFile: No standalone README or license file among the eight archive entries. A Windows help file is present but was not executed or extracted.
license.distribution: Private test input only. Do not place archive or game data in the source bundle or generic image. Official demo listing is evidence of acquisition source, not a grant of redistribution rights.

verification.engineDetection: passed: scumm:puttzoo — Putt-Putt Saves the Zoo (Demo/Windows/English) at transferred and installed data paths
verification.interactivePlay: passed for bounded Linux VM walkthrough: entrance and Jungle Dock rendered; pointer interaction changed scenes; car/dog animation and F5 menu response observed. This is not a full playthrough or physical Pi acceptance.
verification.audioOutput: audibility unverified: ALSA device reported RUNNING, but logs contain buffer underruns; no listening acceptance recorded
verification.saveLoad: not verified: S and L did not expose original save/load dialogs; F5 Save rejected menu saving and instructed use of the in-game interface; no game save created (only timestamps metadata present)
verification.guestDataHashes: passed: all five extracted HE SHA256/size records match installed files; excluded archive members absent
verification.guestDataPermissions: passed: installed root:root 0444; separate writable user config and saves

rendererTrials.notes: Menu Execute reached ScummVM but this renderer failed. The later explicit OpenGL trial passed the bounded GUI walkthrough.

rendererTrials.status: passed bounded Linux VM rendering and interaction
rendererTrials.notes: Native window rendered entrance and Jungle Dock with animation. Does not certify audio, save/load, complete demo compatibility or physical Pi graphics.

visualEvidence.description: Root CUA screenshot of the Zoo Jungle Dock scene in a native window above the kidOS desktop

verification.observationSource: Root performed the interactive QEMU GUI walkthrough and reported entrance-to-Jungle-Dock navigation, animation, F5 response and S/L results; the Library agent reviewed the saved screenshot and CLI logs.

supportEvidence.compatibilityRating: Putt-Putt Saves the Zoo listed Excellent by upstream; that general support rating is separate from this manifest's bounded local demo checks.

saveLimitations.globalMenu: Upstream 2.9.0 canSaveGameStateCurrently and canLoadGameStateCurrently return false for HE >=62 and require the original in-game save/load interface because of glitches.
saveLimitations.demoSave: During the local Linux VM walkthrough, S and L did not open original save/load dialogs. F5 Save said: This game does not support saving from the menu. Use in-game interface. No game save was created, so save/load acceptance remains incomplete; do not promise resumable demo progress.
saveLimitations.autosave: Generic ScummVM autosave documentation does not establish save support for this demo.
saveLimitations.originalControls: Publisher-linked full-game manual pages 3–4 documents S for Save and L for Load. These controls were tested in this demo without a save/load dialog appearing; the full-game manual is not proof that the demo includes saving. F5 opened the ScummVM menu.

launch.notes: OpenGL arguments match the verified supervised Linux VM renderer; physical Pi rendering remains untested. Paths are placeholders. --path must precede --detect/--auto-detect. --window-size=W,H is OpenGL-only. Do not use --demo-mode for this game: upstream documents it only for Maniac Mansion/The 7th Guest.
